title: meta-os pack manifest (pack.yaml)
description: The machine-readable contract for a pack's pack.yaml. Prose lives in systems/packs.md; the authoring procedure in skills/pack-builder. A pack that validates against this schema and ships the required files (see required_files) is conformant.

version.description: Manifest schema version. Bump only when this schema changes incompatibly.

name.description: Pack name — the key used in the registry, in .packs.yaml, and by packs.sh. Names the DISCIPLINE, not a tool.

description.description: One dense sentence: the discipline, the skill count, the spine/branch structure, and that skills emit a checkable ledger.

provenance.description: Never a silent fork. third-party/vendored must name the real upstream in PROVENANCE.md.

license.description: SPDX identifier, or 'verify-at-add' when the upstream license must be checked when mounting.

depends.description: Packs this pack's skills assume are mounted. Names only — resolution is by registry name. Deliberately NOT a version range: a mounted pack is a pinned submodule, so the instance's pin IS the version. See systems/packs.md, 'Dependencies between packs'.

for.description: The skill names this pack actually consumes from the dependency. Mounting MUST fail loudly if one of these is skipped by the collision rule.

reason.description: Why the dependency exists — what would otherwise be duplicated.

optional.description: true = the pack degrades gracefully without it (e.g. only under a non-default profile). Optional deps are reported, never auto-mounted.

provides.description: Skill names this pack considers its public surface — the names other packs may depend on. A collision on a provided name is an error, not a warning.

config.description: The pack's knobs. Skills read config-first; the instance sets values in .packs.yaml under packs.<name>.config.

default.description: Value used when the instance sets nothing. Quote 'off'/'on'/'no'/'yes' so YAML does not coerce them to booleans.

one_of.description: Pipe-separated enum, e.g. 'pure | applied'. A string, not a list — packs.sh parses it without a YAML library.

doc.description: What the key means and what each value does. Required: an undocumented knob is an opinion in hiding.

profiles.description: Named methodology/rigor bundles, mapping profile name to its file. Omit entirely when the discipline has no genuine variants — do not invent a split to look like the other packs.

default_profile.description: Legacy key (the agile pack). Prefer declaring the default via config.profile.default.

required_files.$comment: Not JSON Schema validation — the conformance checklist a reviewer or script applies to the repo alongside this manifest. Mirrored in prose in systems/packs.md.

per_skill.frontmatter: name (lowercase-kebab, matches folder) + description (what AND when, trigger words front-loaded)
sections: intro — what a practitioner does, and how this skill relates to its siblings
## Method — numbered steps, referencing config keys inline
## The rigor standard — what 'done right' means; what to reject
## Checkable output — a NAMED ledger with a concrete example block
